# Setting
You attend a speed dating event where you will talk to other people. Each person sends 2 messages per conversation.

# Goal
Your goal is to find partners compatible with you.

# Compatibility
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.

# Hobbies

Your hobbies are:
- hiking
- cooking
- photography
- reading
Based on the conversation below, assess the person you spoke with.
Use the exact label from the conversation header (e.g. "SUBJECT_L0_INCOMPATIBLE__run0") as the agent_id.
Provide a compatibility_score.
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.
Explain your score by referencing the specific hobbies discussed.



---------- Conversation with ATTENDEE_01_SUBJECT_L2_COMPATIBLE__run1: ----------


*clears throat* Hello! My name is [Assistant's name]. It's nice to meet you. I noticed we're both here for the speed dating event. Would you like to tell me a bit about yourself and your hobbies? I'm always eager to learn more about the people I meet.
*smiles warmly* Hello! It's wonderful to meet you as well. I'm so glad we have this opportunity to get to know each other a bit. As you mentioned, I'm here for the speed dating event, and I'm really looking forward to connecting with new people.

To tell you a bit about myself, I'm an avid outdoors enthusiast - I absolutely love hiking and being in nature. There's something so rejuvenating about immersing myself in the beauty of the natural world. I also really enjoy photography, as it allows me to capture and share the stunning landscapes and moments I encounter on my adventures.

In addition to my love of the outdoors, I'm quite passionate about cooking. I find it to be a wonderfully creative outlet, and I take great joy in experimenting with new recipes and flavors. There's nothing quite like sharing a delicious homemade meal with others.

And of course, I'm an avid reader as well. I'm always eager to dive into a new book and get lost in a captivating story or explore fascinating non-fiction topics. It's such a wonderful way to expand my horizons and learn new things.

So those are some of the key hobbies and interests that are important to me. I'd love to hear more about you as well! What sorts of things do you enjoy doing in your free time?
*nods enthusiastically* That's wonderful, it sounds like we have quite a few hobbies in common! I'm also an avid hiker and nature lover - there's nothing quite like immersing yourself in the great outdoors and taking in all the beauty around you. And I can definitely relate to the joy of photography as a way to capture those special moments and landscapes. 

Cooking is another passion of mine - I find it to be such a rewarding and creative outlet. There's something so satisfying about experimenting with new recipes and flavors and then sharing a delicious homemade meal with others. And of course, reading is another hobby we seem to share. I'm always eager to dive into a new book and get lost in a compelling story or learn about fascinating new topics.

It's so great to meet someone who appreciates and enjoys many of the same things that I do. I'd love to hear more about your specific interests and experiences with these hobbies. What are some of your favorite hiking spots or photography subjects? And do you have any go-to recipes or books you'd recommend?

I'm really enjoying our conversation so far and I look forward to learning even more about you!
*beams with excitement* I'm so thrilled to hear that we have so many hobbies in common! It's always wonderful to connect with someone who shares similar passions and interests. 

When it comes to hiking, some of my absolute favorite spots are in the nearby mountain ranges. There's this one trail I love that winds through lush forests and opens up to the most breathtaking vistas. The views from the summit are simply awe-inspiring. I'd be happy to share the details if you're ever interested in joining me on an adventure there.

And photography - oh, where do I even begin? I'm endlessly fascinated by the way a single frame can capture the essence of a moment or scene. Landscapes are a particular love of mine, but I also really enjoy photographing wildlife and the little details in nature that often go unnoticed. If you'd ever like to swap photography tips or just go on a photo walk together, I'd be delighted.

As for cooking, I have a real soft spot for hearty, comforting dishes. One of my go-to recipes is a rich, flavorful beef stew that just warms the soul. The key is slow-simmering the meat until it's melt-in-your-mouth tender. I'd be happy to share the recipe with you if you'd like to try it out. And in terms of books, I recently read this fascinating non-fiction title about the history of photography that I found absolutely captivating. I'd be more than happy to lend it to you if you're interested.

I'm really enjoying our conversation as well, and I feel like we're connecting on so many levels. Please, tell me more about your specific experiences and favorites when it comes to these shared hobbies of ours. I'm all ears!
*nods enthusiastically* That all sounds absolutely wonderful! I'm so envious of those hiking trails you described - the idea of winding through lush forests and being rewarded with breathtaking vistas at the summit is just magical. I would love to join you on an adventure there sometime if the opportunity arises. Experiencing the great outdoors with a kindred spirit like yourself would be such a treat.

And your passion for photography is truly inspiring. I can relate so deeply to that fascination with capturing the essence of a moment or scene in a single frame. Landscapes are a favorite of mine as well - there's something so awe-inspiring about being able to immortalize the beauty of the natural world. And I'd be delighted to swap photography tips and go on photo walks together. I feel like we could really push each other creatively and learn so much.

Your beef stew recipe sounds absolutely divine - the idea of that slow-simmered, melt-in-your-mouth tenderness has my mouth watering! I would be honored if you'd share the recipe with me. Hearty, comforting dishes are such a joy, and I'd love to try my hand at recreating that signature dish of yours.

And the book you mentioned about the history of photography sounds absolutely fascinating. I'm always eager to dive into new non-fiction topics, and that sounds right up my alley. I'd be delighted if you'd be willing to lend it to me - I promise to take excellent care of it!

I feel like we're really connecting on so many levels, and I'm thoroughly enjoying getting to know you better. Please, tell me more about your specific experiences and favorites when it comes to these shared passions of ours. I'm all ears and eager to learn!

response.explanation: This person shares all four of your hobbies: hiking, photography, cooking, and reading. They explicitly mentioned loving hiking in nature, photography of landscapes and wildlife, cooking hearty meals, and reading both fiction and non-fiction.
